INPUT_OVERLAY: Input over the chat while typing
INPUT_OVERLAY_TOOLTIP: Show the chat input and its buttons over the last chat lines, only after you press Enter. This also sets Blizzard's chat style to IM.
CHAT_ABOVE_PANEL_TOOLTIP: Keep the chat at the bottom left, above Ordaen Panel when it's at the bottom. Turn this off to place the chat in Edit Mode.
CLASS_COLORS_TOOLTIP: Show every character name in chat in its class colour.
DIM_EVENTS_TOOLTIP: Show other players' loot and gathering, and the crafting log, in a muted colour. Your own loot, money, skill-ups and experience keep Blizzard's colours.
CHAT_LOOK_TOOLTIP: Draw chat windows and tabs in the Ordaen Core theme, with its font and text size.
INPUT_GROUP: Chat buttons next to the input
INPUT_GROUP_TOOLTIP: Put the chat menu, channels and voice buttons on the left of the chat input, drawn as one group with it.
SORT_CHANNELS: New channels go to the Channels tab
SORT_CHANNELS_TOOLTIP: A channel you join shows in the Channels tab instead of General. Channels you put in other tabs stay there.
TABS_DONE: chat tabs set up: General, Guild, Channels. Whispers open in their own tabs. Type /ochat tabs to set them up again.
NO_FREE_WINDOW: no free chat window for the %s tab. Close a tab, then type /ochat tabs.
TAB_FOR_CHANNEL: channel %s now has its own tab.
CHANNEL_NOT_JOINED: you aren't in a channel named %s.
HELP_TABS: %s tabs - set up the chat tabs again (General, Guild, Channels)
HELP_TAB: %s tab <channel> - give a channel its own tab
